programmes.d: Guest star Ken Berry joins Carol, Dick, Vicki, and Tim for the musical movie spoof "Stolen Serenade."

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Gladys Knight and the Pips, Jim Bailey, O.C. Smith, Robert Klein, Jackie De Shannon, and Satani Demon.
Dallas heartthrob Patrick Duffy says he always dreamed of becoming a TV star but now he wants to change his nice guy image. Also reveals his love for off-road racing.
Comic great and sometimes skier Jerry Seinfeld talks about keeping warm on the slopes and decorating his living room with mirrors. Also appearing in this episode is Dallas star Victoria Principal.

programmes.t: Comedy Legends from The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Bill Dana's "Jose Jimenez: Navy Crewman"; Stiller and Meara's "Funny Commercials"; Hendra and Ullett's "International Airlines"; Jackie Mason's "Movies, Family, and Colombus"
Hollywood heavyweights Jack Lemmon and Walter Matthau regale Johnny with tales of making 5 movies together and one near-death stunt gone very wrong.
Carol welcomes the great Madeline Kahn to the show! Ms. Kahn appears in the latest sketch with "The Family" as the pretentious director and star of a play in which Eunice has been cast.
Tonight's guest: Mr. Steve Lawrence! Steve joins Carol in a sketch about a traveling couple sharing some honesty with each other on a plane they think is about to crash.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: The incredible Rita Moreno guest stars, appearing in a sketch as a nurse to the accident-prone Carol.
Comedy superstar Chevy Chase stops by to talk about having perfect pitch and guest hosting the show. Siskel & Ebert reveal their favorite Chevy Chase movie.
The first lady of TV, Betty White, critiques Johnny’s sketch comedy performance and quizzes him on the wonders of nature.
Maggie Smith returns to guest star as the erudite teacher of Eunice and Ed's son Bubba in another installment of "The Family." Also: a newly remodeled kitchen falls apart around Carol and Harvey.
Jay Leno describes his parent's amazingly happy marriage, his busy stand-up schedule, and getting recognized in a New York City deli.
Stardom is bad for your health. Walter Matthau dons dark glasses to disguise an eye problem, jokes about his roommate in the hospital and the awful food.
Witness Dave Thomas' Bob Hope and Andrew Dice Clay impressions. Plus: Buddy Hackett tells jokes and Teresa Ganzel also appears.
Who doesn’t love a Koala bear? When Johnny holds the bear, the Koala doesn’t want to let go so Joan Embery has to pry the bear away.
Garry Shandling is ALWAYS funny, whether he's talking about his hair, pets, or traffic tickets.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: The season-ending 'Family Show' features the best variety show ensemble on television with the epic showbiz extravaganza 'The Doily Sisters'
Author and comedian, Jeff Foxworthy chats about his bestselling book, You Might be a Redneck if…. Also on the show is Dallas star, Patrick Duffy.
Carol's guest tonight is the lovable Ken Berry, who stars with Carol as unsuccessful Western movie stars in "The Saga Of Lily And Billy." Also: Dick Cavett crashes Carol's Q&A session.
Tonight features Carol in a dual role for a Late, Late Movie presentation of "A Swiped Life"-- take-off of the 1946 film "A Stolen Life", which starred Bette Davis as twin sisters in a love triangle.
Frequent guest Nanette Fabray settles in for another appearance on "As The Stomach Turns." Also featured: "Carol & Sis" go gaga over Roger's briefcase, which is surprisingly filled with cash.
Tonight's guest stars are Alan King and Lena Zavaroni! In sketches set on Hollywood Boulevard, a baseball game, and a bus stop, Carol and company prove that big laughs can be found everywhere.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Sketches include Carol as a increasingly-less dignified princess rehearsing a toast, and a peek inside the United States Safety Committee.
Bernadette Peters and Tim Conway guest star in a head-spinning installment of "As The Stomach Turns" spoofing "The Exorcist" in the process. Also: Tim and Harvey play Japanese sailors in a tiny sub.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Buddy Holly and the Crickets, Sam Cooke, Jean Carroll, The Rays, Polly Bergen, Douglas Fairbanks, Jr., and Bobby Helms.
You get two Carols for the price of one when Carol Channing guests! Ms. Channing joins up with Ms. Burnett for the Q&A, but they're at odds in a sketch about a golddigger out for an old man's money.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Comedian Scoey Mitchell and singer Bobbie Gentry are Carol's guests for this episode that features a certain monarch's debut in variety programming
SNL alum Martin Short admits he was a singer before taking up comedy. Shows a clip from his HBO special. Model-turned-TV-star, Cybill Shepherd talks about her kids, breastfeeding and divorce.
Guest star Bernadette Peters joins the cast on the playground for a sketch about bratty kids. Also, The Early Early Show presents another cornball classic: "The Most Happy Stella."
Nanette Fabray and Steve Lawrence guest star in an episode saluting Columbia Pictures classic movies by spoofing "Middle Of The Night", "From Here To Eternity", and "Gilda."
Isabella Rossellini talks about being raised in France and Italy, plus Martin Short is ready to cook a goose.
This episode features Harvey as a man faking whiplash after an accident with Carol. And on "The Family", Mama, Ed, and Eunice are invited to Mickey's place for a celebratory Chinese dinner.

programmes.t: Friars Club Roast of Ed Sullivan
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan's 10th anniversary in television roast by The Friars Club was originally broadcast November 9th, 1958, hosted by Jack Carter and featuring appearances by friends, colleagues, and notable surprise guests along the way!
